leftoverServers.title_one: A server is still running from last time
leftoverServers.title_other: Servers are still running from last time
leftoverServers.description_one: Ingot closed without stopping it, so its console is gone: Ingot can't send commands or save its world. It keeps its port and world busy until stopped.
leftoverServers.description_other: Ingot closed without stopping them, so their consoles are gone: Ingot can't send commands or save their worlds. They keep their ports and worlds busy until stopped.
leftoverServers.stopNote: Stopping ends it right away. Anything since the last autosave (a few minutes at most) is lost, and the world itself stays fine.

duplicateInstance.description: Makes a separate copy with the same mods, configs, resource packs and settings. Changes to one don't touch the other, so the copy is a safe place to try a new version or mods.
duplicateInstance.copyWorldsDesc: Without them the copy starts with no singleplayer worlds.
duplicateInstance.note: Playtime starts at zero. Logs, crash reports and screenshots stay with the original.
duplicateInstance.running: The game is running. Close it first so the worlds are copied as they were saved, or copy without worlds.

quitDialog.saving_other: Saving worlds and stopping. This can take up to 30 seconds.

quitDialog.games_other: Your games keep running either way. Ingot picks them up again when you open it.
